title: "My anisong dashboard"
format:
  dashboard:
    logo: "images/logo.png"
    orientation: rows
    css: styles.css
---

```{r, load_packages}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r, import_data}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
gs4_deauth()
sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uNYfeghUGPkpMYVwhLSkxx81_x8Syr7t9W8D4Ry4hag/edit?gid=0#gid=0"

df_op <- read_sheet(sheet_url, sheet = "OP") %>% mutate(Type = "OP")
df_ed <- read_sheet(sheet_url, sheet = "ED") %>% mutate(Type = "ED")
df <- bind_rows(df_op, df_ed) %>%
  mutate(
    Artist = case_when(
      tolower(trimws(Artist)) == "yoasobi" ~ "Yoasobi",
      tolower(trimws(Artist)) == "supercell" ~ "Supercell",
      tolower(trimws(Artist)) == "yui" ~ "YUI",
      TRUE ~ trimws(Artist)
    )
  )

# Serialize to JSON for client-side interaction
songs_json <- toJSON(df, dataframe = "rows")
```

## Row {height="18%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox

list(

)
```

## Row {height="82%"}

### Column {width="55%"}

::: {.card}
::: {.card-header}
Song List
:::

::: {.card-body}

```{=html}
<div class="tracklist-header-wrapper">
  <div class="cyber-search-wrapper">
    <input 
      type="text" 
      id="searchInput" 
      class="cyber-search-input" 
      placeholder="🔍 Cari judul lagu, anime, atau artis..." 
      oninput="handleFilterChange()" 
    />
  </div>

  <div class="filter-chips-container" id="filterChipsContainer">
    <button class="filter-chip active" id="chip-ALL" data-type="ALL" onclick="setTypeFilter('ALL')">
      ✨ Semua (<span id="count-ALL">0</span>)
    </button>
    <button class="filter-chip op-chip" id="chip-OP" data-type="OP" onclick="setTypeFilter('OP')">
      🎬 Opening (<span id="count-OP">0</span>)
    </button>
    <button class="filter-chip ed-chip" id="chip-ED" data-type="ED" onclick="setTypeFilter('ED')">
      🌙 Ending (<span id="count-ED">0</span>)
    </button>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="cyber-list-container" id="songListContainer">
  <!-- Song items will be rendered by JavaScript -->
</div>
```

:::

### Column {width="45%"}

::: {.card}
::: {.card-header}
Music Player
:::

::: {.card-body}

```{=html}
<div class="player-outer">
  <div class="player-frame-box" id="playerFrameBox">
    <iframe 
      id="mainVideoPlayer" 
      src="" 
      title="Music Player" 
      referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
      allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" 
      allowfullscreen>
    </iframe>
  </div>

  <div class="now-playing-banner" id="nowPlayingBanner">
    <div class="now-playing-header">
      <span class="now-playing-tag">NOW PLAYING</span>
    </div>
    <h3 class="now-playing-song-title" id="nowPlayingTitle">-</h3>
    <div class="now-playing-details">
      <span id="nowPlayingTypeBadge" class="badge-type badge-op">🎬 OP</span>
      <span class="badge-anime" id="nowPlayingAnime">-</span>
      <span class="badge-artist" id="nowPlayingArtist">-</span>
    </div>

    <!-- Player Controls Bar -->
    <div class="player-controls-bar">
      <button class="btn-player-ctrl" onclick="playPrevSong()" title="Lagu Sebelumnya">
        ⏮️ Prev
      </button>
      <button class="btn-player-ctrl" onclick="playNextSong()" title="Lagu Berikutnya">
        Next ⏭️
      </button>
      <button id="btnShuffleToggle" class="btn-player-ctrl" onclick="toggleShuffle()" title="Acak Urutan Lagu">
        🔀 Random: <span id="shuffleStateText">OFF</span>
      </button>
      <button id="btnAutoplayToggle" class="btn-player-ctrl btn-toggle-active-cyan" onclick="toggleAutoplay()" title="Otomatis Putar Lagu Berikutnya">
        🔁 Autoplay: <span id="autoplayStateText">ON</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const songs = `r songs_json`;

let currentActiveIndex = 0;
let currentTypeFilter = 'ALL';
let currentFilteredSongs = [...songs];
let isAutoplay = true;
let isShuffle = false;
let ytPlayer = null;
let ytApiReady = false;

function escapeHTML(str) {
  if (typeof str !== 'string') return "";
  return str
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
}

function getYoutubeId(url) {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return "";
  const match = url.match(/(?:embed\/|v=|vi\/|youtu\.be\/|\/v\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/);
  if (match && /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11}$/.test(match[1])) {
    return match[1];
  }
  const parts = url.split("?")[0].split("/");
  const candidate = parts[parts.length - 1] || "";
  return /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11}$/.test(candidate) ? candidate : "";
}

function getThumb(url) {
  const id = getYoutubeId(url);
  return id ? `https://img.youtube.com/vi/${id}/mqdefault.jpg` : "";
}

// Load YouTube IFrame API script
(function loadYouTubeAPI() {
  const tag = document.createElement('script');
  tag.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
  const firstScriptTag = document.getElementsByTagName('script')[0];
  firstScriptTag.parentNode.insertBefore(tag, firstScriptTag);
})();

window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = function() {
  ytApiReady = true;
  initYouTubePlayer();
};

function initYouTubePlayer() {
  if (ytPlayer) return;
  ytPlayer = new YT.Player('mainVideoPlayer', {
    events: {
      'onStateChange': onPlayerStateChange
    }
  });
}

function onPlayerStateChange(event) {
  // YT.PlayerState.ENDED is 0
  if (event.data === 0) {
    if (isAutoplay) {
      playNextSong();
    }
  }
}

function playSong(globalIndex, shouldAutoplay = true) {
  if (globalIndex < 0 || globalIndex >= songs.length) return;
  currentActiveIndex = globalIndex;
  const song = songs[globalIndex];
  const videoId = getYoutubeId(song.link);

  // Update YouTube Player using strictly sanitized videoId
  if (ytPlayer && typeof ytPlayer.loadVideoById === 'function') {
    if (shouldAutoplay) {
      ytPlayer.loadVideoById(videoId);
    } else {
      ytPlayer.cueVideoById(videoId);
    }
  } else {
    const iframe = document.getElementById("mainVideoPlayer");
    if (iframe) {
      iframe.src = videoId 
        ? `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${videoId}?enablejsapi=1&autoplay=${shouldAutoplay ? 1 : 0}`
        : "about:blank";
    }
  }

  // Update banner info
  const titleEl = document.getElementById("nowPlayingTitle");
  if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = song.Title;

  const animeEl = document.getElementById("nowPlayingAnime");
  if (animeEl) animeEl.textContent = "📺 " + song.Anime;

  const artistEl = document.getElementById("nowPlayingArtist");
  if (artistEl) artistEl.textContent = "🎤 " + song.Artist;

  const typeBadgeEl = document.getElementById("nowPlayingTypeBadge");
  if (typeBadgeEl) {
    if (song.Type === "ED") {
      typeBadgeEl.className = "badge-type badge-ed";
      typeBadgeEl.textContent = "🌙 ED";
    } else {
      typeBadgeEl.className = "badge-type badge-op";
      typeBadgeEl.textContent = "🎬 OP";
    }
  }

  // Update active state in song cards
  updateCardActiveStates();
}

function updateCardActiveStates() {
  document.querySelectorAll(".song-card").forEach(card => {
    const cardIdx = parseInt(card.getAttribute("data-index"), 10);
    const icon = card.querySelector(".play-icon");
    const pill = card.querySelector(".live-pill");

    if (cardIdx === currentActiveIndex) {
      card.classList.add("active");
      if (icon) icon.textContent = "🔊";
      if (pill) pill.style.display = "inline-block";
    } else {
      card.classList.remove("active");
      if (icon) icon.textContent = "▶";
      if (pill) pill.style.display = "none";
    }
  });
}

function playNextSong() {
  const list = currentFilteredSongs.length > 0 ? currentFilteredSongs : songs;
  if (list.length === 0) return;

  let nextSong;
  if (isShuffle) {
    let available = list.filter(s => s.Title !== songs[currentActiveIndex].Title);
    if (available.length === 0) available = list;
    const randIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * available.length);
    nextSong = available[randIdx];
  } else {
    const currentPos = list.findIndex(s => s.Title === songs[currentActiveIndex].Title && s.Artist === songs[currentActiveIndex].Artist);
    const nextPos = (currentPos + 1) % list.length;
    nextSong = list[nextPos];
  }

  const nextGlobalIdx = songs.findIndex(s => s.Title === nextSong.Title && s.Artist === nextSong.Artist);
  if (nextGlobalIdx !== -1) {
    playSong(nextGlobalIdx, true);
  }
}

function playPrevSong() {
  const list = currentFilteredSongs.length > 0 ? currentFilteredSongs : songs;
  if (list.length === 0) return;

  const currentPos = list.findIndex(s => s.Title === songs[currentActiveIndex].Title && s.Artist === songs[currentActiveIndex].Artist);
  const prevPos = (currentPos - 1 + list.length) % list.length;
  const prevSong = list[prevPos];

  const prevGlobalIdx = songs.findIndex(s => s.Title === prevSong.Title && s.Artist === prevSong.Artist);
  if (prevGlobalIdx !== -1) {
    playSong(prevGlobalIdx, true);
  }
}

function toggleAutoplay() {
  isAutoplay = !isAutoplay;
  const btn = document.getElementById("btnAutoplayToggle");
  const text = document.getElementById("autoplayStateText");
  if (isAutoplay) {
    btn.classList.add("btn-toggle-active-cyan");
    text.textContent = "ON";
  } else {
    btn.classList.remove("btn-toggle-active-cyan");
    text.textContent = "OFF";
  }
}

function toggleShuffle() {
  isShuffle = !isShuffle;
  const btn = document.getElementById("btnShuffleToggle");
  const text = document.getElementById("shuffleStateText");
  if (isShuffle) {
    btn.classList.add("btn-toggle-active-pink");
    text.textContent = "ON";
  } else {
    btn.classList.remove("btn-toggle-active-pink");
    text.textContent = "OFF";
  }
}

function setTypeFilter(type) {
  currentTypeFilter = type;
  document.querySelectorAll(".filter-chip").forEach(chip => {
    chip.classList.toggle("active", chip.getAttribute("data-type") === type);
  });
  handleFilterChange();
}

function handleFilterChange() {
  const query = (document.getElementById("searchInput").value || "").toLowerCase().trim();

  currentFilteredSongs = songs.filter(s => {
    const matchesType = currentTypeFilter === 'ALL' || s.Type === currentTypeFilter;
    const matchesQuery = !query || 
      (s.Title && s.Title.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
      (s.Anime && s.Anime.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
      (s.Artist && s.Artist.toLowerCase().includes(query));
    return matchesType && matchesQuery;
  });

  renderSongList(currentFilteredSongs);
}

function renderSongList(list) {
  const container = document.getElementById("songListContainer");
  if (!container) return;

  if (list.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = `
      <div style="text-align: center; padding: 48px 16px; color: #8b95b5;">
        <p style="font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 6px;">❌ Tidak ada lagu ditemukan</p>
        <span style="font-size: 0.85rem;">Coba ganti filter opening/ending atau kata kunci pencarian.</span>
      </div>
    `;
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = list.map(song => {
    const origIndex = songs.findIndex(s => s.Title === song.Title && s.Artist === song.Artist);
    const isSelected = origIndex === currentActiveIndex;
    const thumb = getThumb(song.link);
    const isOP = song.Type === "OP";
    const safeTitle = escapeHTML(song.Title);
    const safeAnime = escapeHTML(song.Anime);
    const safeArtist = escapeHTML(song.Artist);

    return `
      <div class="song-card ${isSelected ? 'active' : ''}" 
           data-index="${origIndex}" 
           onclick="playSong(${origIndex}, true)">
        <div class="song-thumb-wrapper">
          <img class="song-thumb" src="${thumb}" alt="${safeTitle}" loading="lazy" />
          <div class="play-badge-overlay">
            <span class="play-icon">${isSelected ? '🔊' : '▶'}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="song-content">
          <div class="song-title-row">
            <span class="song-title">${safeTitle}</span>
            <span class="live-pill" style="display: ${isSelected ? 'inline-block' : 'none'};">PLAYING</span>
          </div>
          <div class="song-tags">
            <span class="badge-type ${isOP ? 'badge-op' : 'badge-ed'}">
              ${isOP ? '🎬 OP' : '🌙 ED'}
            </span>
            <span class="badge-anime" title="${safeAnime}">📺 ${safeAnime}</span>
            <span class="badge-artist" title="${safeArtist}">🎤 ${safeArtist}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join("");
}

function updateChipCounts() {
  const totalAll = songs.length;
  const totalOP = songs.filter(s => s.Type === "OP").length;
  const totalED = songs.filter(s => s.Type === "ED").length;

  const countAll = document.getElementById("count-ALL");
  if (countAll) countAll.textContent = totalAll;
  const countOP = document.getElementById("count-OP");
  if (countOP) countOP.textContent = totalOP;
  const countED = document.getElementById("count-ED");
  if (countED) countED.textContent = totalED;
}

function initPlayer() {
  if (typeof songs !== 'undefined' && songs.length > 0) {
    updateChipCounts();
    renderSongList(songs);
    playSong(0, false);
  }
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initPlayer);
} else {
  initPlayer();
}
</script>
```

:::
